title: 第5章 开大醮求朝煌第6章 大醮成采正炁
content_zh:
三日之后，黄昏之时。
陆玄盘膝坐在精舍院中，双目紧闭，心神下沉。
“咚！”
霎时间，心脏跳动之声如擂鼓一般响起，泵动血液，带来了源源不绝，似乎永不枯竭的精力。
这是可以赤手空拳搏斗虎豹，厮杀豺狼的力量。
这就是修行第一境——胎息。
胎息圆满，炼精得成，肉身已是凡人之巅峰。
前身修行三载，方才成就此境。
可惜一朝炼炁失败，郁郁寡欢，强行观念道经，想要寻失败之因，但却因此心神枯竭而亡，被陆玄得入此身。
鉴天教道经玄妙，真有伟力，强行观之念之，真真有风险。
好在，心神死而魂灭，但肉身依存，为陆玄留下了一份好底子。
“这就是修行啊……”
虽然这些时日已经完全掌控了这股力量，可真当握拳之时，气力奔涌，陆玄还是忍不住感叹。
这也是他非要二次开启炼炁大醮的原因。
修行太过美妙，令人沉沦，两世为人，必要追逐之。
“算算时间，也差不多了……”
陆玄睁眼，看向已经暗沉下来的天空，缓缓起身。
三日静心，收集大醮之灵材，今日气清云散，正是开启大醮的好时机。
跃过去，海阔天空，跃不过去，陆玄也认了。
左右已经见识了修行的风采。

一念至此，陆玄轻轻摩挲了腰间的玉符。
“咻！”
霎时间，天穹之上一朵白云倏然飞下，落在院中，陆玄一跃而起，乘云而飞，向着东方而去。
……
……
一炷香后，陆玄在一处巍峨青山之前下了云。
此山高大，矗立群峰，好似一尊巨塔。
山间无有道路，仅在山巅之上修有一殿，占地数亩，甚是广阔。
此时天色已经暗沉，殿中有灿灿光晕亮起，照出巍巍之轮廓，独亮于此山，煞是好看。
殿门大开，内中仅有一中年道人伏案观书，神情自得。
“嗯？”
但此刻，听到了陆玄的腾云之声，道人当即抬首，看了过来。
“见过值守。”
陆玄踏进殿门，对道人打了一个稽首。
content_en:
Three days later, at dusk.
Lu Xuan sat cross-legged in the courtyard of the monastery, his eyes closed and his mind sinking.
"Boom!"
In an instant, the beating of the heart sounded like a drum, pumping the blood, bringing an endless stream of energy that seemed never to be exhausted.
This is the power that can fight tigers and leopards with bare hands, and kill jackals.
This is the first state of practice - fetal breath.
The fetal breath is perfect, the essence is refined, and the physical body is the pinnacle of mortals.
It took my predecessor three years of practice to achieve this state.
Unfortunately, once he failed to refine Qi, he became depressed and forced to meditate on the Taoist scriptures in an attempt to find the cause of the failure. However, he died of mental exhaustion and was taken into this body by Lu Xuan.
The Jiantian Taoist scriptures are mysterious and powerful, but forcing them to meditate on them is really risky.
Fortunately, when the mind dies, the soul is destroyed, but the body remains, leaving a good foundation for Lu Xuan.
"This is cultivation..."
Although he has completely controlled this power these days, Lu Xuan still couldn't help but sigh when the power surged when he clenched his fist.
This was also the reason why he had to start the Qi Refining Jiao for the second time.
Cultivation is so wonderful that it makes people sink. As a human being in two lives, we must pursue it.
"Calculate the time, it's almost..."
Lu Xuan opened his eyes, looked at the darkening sky, and stood up slowly.
After three days of meditation and collecting spiritual materials for the Dajiao, today the energy is clear and the clouds have dispersed. It is a good time to start the Dajiao.
Jump over, the sea and the sky are vast, but if you can't jump over, Lu Xuan also admits it.
You have already seen the elegance of spiritual practice.
After thinking about this, Lu Xuan gently touched the jade talisman on his waist.
"Phew!"
In an instant, a white cloud suddenly flew down from the sky and landed in the courtyard. Lu Xuan jumped up, took advantage of the cloud and flew towards the east.
…
…
After burning a stick of incense, Lu Xuan came to the clouds in front of a majestic green mountain.
This mountain is tall and towering, like a giant tower.
There are no roads in the mountains. There is only a palace built on the top of the mountain, covering an area of ​​several acres and is very vast.
At this time, the sky was already dark, and there was a bright halo of light in the hall, illuminating the towering outline, which was shining alone on this mountain, which was really beautiful.
The door of the palace was wide open, and there was only a middle-aged Taoist inside, looking at a book with a contented expression.
"Huh?"
But at this moment, after hearing Lu Xuan's soaring voice, the Taoist immediately raised his head and looked over.
"Seen the guard."
Lu Xuan stepped into the palace gate and slapped the Taoist on his head.
